_how: Add an item and push. status: shipped | approved | review | testing | waiting | planned. Shipped items need date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM) and type (new | update | fix | site). Unreleased items never get a date.

releases.title: ORB Pro Knightfall MK2 for NinjaTrader 8
releases.body: Native NinjaTrader 8 version of the strategy. Approved by NinjaTrader; final prep for release. Ships as v1.2 with both variants (Stock and Runner), the trailing stop and the No-Hedge ORB Cap, matching TradingView. Auto Trade on or alert-only, no webhooks or bridge service.

releases.title: TradingView Marketplace move
releases.body: TradingView is moving paid invite-only scripts to its Marketplace. How FSD-X scripts are delivered on TradingView may change. Waiting on TradingView.

releases.title: Raven, Volume Engine and Stack V1 on NinjaTrader 8
releases.body: Native NinjaTrader 8 versions of Raven, Volume Engine and Stack V1, coming after Knightfall's NinjaTrader release.

releases.title: Knightfall now has two variants
releases.body: Pick a Variant at the top of the settings. Variant 1 — Stock is the original Knightfall, locked to the stock settings. Variant 2 — Runner holds full size for TP2, trails the stop once TP1 is reached, and caps the stop at the far ORB edge. Custom unlocks every setting. Risk per trade stays yours on every variant. After updating, open the settings and choose Defaults → Reset settings. Compare both variants.

releases.title: No-Hedge ORB Cap and % of TP2 trail trigger
releases.body: Two new settings in Custom. No-Hedge ORB Cap: if the stop would sit beyond the far edge of the opening range, it's placed at the edge, so a stopped long never ends up short of the range and the reverse. The trail trigger can now be set as a % of TP2. Variant 2 uses the cap by default.

releases.title: Auto-Trader: variants and trailing stop
releases.body: Same Variant 1, Variant 2 and Custom presets as Knightfall, plus the trailing stop, so Variant 2 runs hands-off. Each variant was matched against Knightfall trade for trade. In Bracket mode the broker bracket holds the original stop and TP2, and a trailed exit is sent as an exit alert. ORB Auto-Trader.

releases.title: Raven: No-Hedge ORB Cap
releases.body: New option, off by default. If the stop would sit beyond the far edge of the opening range, Raven draws it at the edge instead.

releases.title: Backtest Results: Variant 1 and Variant 2
releases.body: A Variant switch on the results page. Variant 2 data is published for the $250 and $400 settings, side by side with Variant 1 over the same dates. Raw Variant 2 exports are on the CSV Data tab. Backtest Results.

releases.title: Live track record moves to Variant 2
releases.body: From Oct 9, 2026 the live record follows Variant 2. Earlier trades stay as they ran, and the switch is marked on the timeline. View the record.

releases.title: FSD-X is an official NinjaTrader Ecosystem vendor
releases.body: NinjaTrader approved FSD-X as an Ecosystem vendor and the NinjaTrader 8 version passed review. Release comes after final prep. NinjaTrader 8.

releases.title: Live track record: one continuous timeline
releases.body: The record now runs from Dec 16, 2025 under FSD-X ORB Pro, with version updates marked on the timeline. Each trade shows how it closed and the most it was up before closing. View the record.

releases.title: Fleet accounts
releases.body: Track a whole fleet of eval and funded accounts in one place on the Accounts page.

releases.title: Raven launched
releases.body: Same ORB detection, stop and target engine as Knightfall, with no grading or filtering. Every breakout is drawn both ways and the read is yours. About Raven.

releases.title: Nightwing tools subscription
releases.body: The member platform and Nexus 2.0 on their own, without the full membership. About Nightwing.

releases.title: Free Indicators page
releases.body: A home for the free scripts, starting with the Arkham ORB Indicator. Free Indicators.

releases.title: Knightfall MK2 backtest data refreshed
releases.body: Lookahead fixes and the day-start side lockout. Backtest research data republished from the new exports.

releases.title: Nexus 2.0.47
releases.body: Nexus now knows which plan you're on and only shows the features that come with it.

releases.title: Knightfall MK2 goes live
releases.body: ORB Pro rebuilt as a strategy, replacing the v5 indicator. Grades, stops and targets are handled by the engine.

releases.title: ORB Pro v5
releases.body: The indicator version of ORB Pro that ran into spring 2026.
